name: Unthread
description: Search conversations, monitor SLAs, and analyze support metrics directly from Claude. Make Unthread a native part of your AI workflow—a support intelligence layer that helps you stay on top of your helpdesk's performance.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Unthread to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Unthread to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://app.unthread.io/api/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Unthread MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Unthread provides these MCP tools: get_current_user, list_conversations, get_conversation_by_id, get_time_series_analytics, list_custom_fields, and get_custom_field.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Unthread?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to Unthread in customer-support on the Manufact MCP catalog include Assembled, Brainfish, ClearFeed, Conduit, and DevRev.
Unthread requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Unthread is developed by Unthread. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
